derivation.behavior: Metalink contributes mirrors, hashes and size to canonical request metadata.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go parses Metalink into standard request/verification inputs instead of a parallel engine.

invariants: Metalink is metadata expansion only; it does not create a parallel transfer or lifecycle implementation.
Mirror URLs are ordered deterministically from source priority/preference hints and normalized by canonical NetworkIntent construction.
Duplicate canonical URLs collapse without changing the highest-priority source choice.
Only checksum algorithms supported by the canonical checksum verifier are admitted.
Conflicting size or same-algorithm checksum evidence fails closed before execution.
Generated transfers are ordinary bodyless GET NetworkIntent values carrying expected size/checksums and canonical mirrors.
